source_message.text:
Because the project centres on encouraging people to purchase my eBook and support me in rebuilding my life, I'm fine with using 'Project Rebuild' for the time being, although I'm open to other ideas.
After we reach our goal of creating a public goods DAO, I want the DAO to build the platform, which I was thinking of calling 'BooksOnChain'
